notes.title: Early access update 1
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyːHello Survivor,ːsteamhappyː

the first update in Early access ist out. First thank to all guys that assisting us and help us with feedback to make the game more your game.

ːsteamfacepalmː Also we get some criticism from people how tell us "asset flipper" and "bad guys", negative criticism makes us also better, we are young people on a big market like steam and haters gonna hate, but we will make a game for the community with the community, so if you wanna hate us, dont buy the game and search a other place to hate. Maybe come back in 6 month and take again a look on the game ːsteamsaltyː

ːsteamhappyː ### UPDATES ###
- Now the trees dropping "Apples" with a low chance
- Apples are a mix from eat and water like in real.
- Apples can be cooked and you will get a "Bakedapple"
- Bakedapple more for hunger and low for thiest.
- Red Chair now can be placed (build menü)
- Wooden Chair now can be placed (build menü)
- Some changes to buildings life and some model issues now fixed
- Now you start at the morning (9am)
- Added 3 new Sounds for footsteps, eat, attack
- Added 1 new Animation for attacking
- Changed some names of items for a better save system


Thanks for Surviving.

notes.title: ** UPDATE ** Save Game System ** EA is COMING **
notes.content:
Hey Surviver,

The SAVESYSTEM Update is now LIVE!!!

So if you press esc ingame you get a menu -> click SAVE GAME for a new Savegame. You overwrite automatic the old one!

If you now close the Game and get again into the Game you will get your Inventory & Hotbar (bottom bar) items back.

***ATTENTION ***
- you will lose all your equiptment if you dont put it into your inventory befor save the game
- all buildings will be distroyed
- you spawn at the start house

** Whats next? **
- Equiptment slots will go into the save system
- a new world is coming (25% finish)


** NEW PARTNER **
- Thanks to Hive for the support!

notes.title: New Update - Backup Damn :(
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Major Patch 3 is now out, hope you find some cool new things, i have a little pc crash and lose ~8 h of work, but now i redone this and we have some new features and new textures. Also a new video is coming (just need to cut it) 

PLEASE REMEMBER: This is a Project for my Streaming community, so if you are not often im my stream maybe you dont buy this game in EA, wait for ~6-9 month that we have enought content for you :) Thanks to the Ultimate Survival Guys that help to give us a good start for this project. Hope to See you on the Forum.

English - New:
- Now you can sleep in the bed at the spawnpoint.
- you can craft now bed (wooden bed)
- water give you 3x more effective!
- zombie meet gives you -40 - +15 hungry
- cooked meet gives you now 2,5x effective
- some crafting times are now faster
- water you can get from bones ... for some time ^^
- some little terrain updates and some other little stuff ;)

Deutsch / German:

Neues:
- Man kann in dem Bett in der Base jetzt schlafen!
- Man kann das Bett nun auch Craften <3
- Wasser bringt jetzt 3x soviel beim trinken
- Verdorbendes Fleisch macht bis zu -40 hunger aber kann auch +15 geben
- Gekochtes Fleisch bringt jetzt 2,5x soviel wie vorher.
- ein paar Craft Zeiten wurden  angepasst.
- Man brauch weniger Clothes für den Schlafsack (glaube den patch ich bald raus) #bettistcooler
- Änderungen der Positionen für Hühner und Zombies, sowie eine weitere Horde wilder Schweine.
- Wasser kann zurzeit aus Knochen gewonnen werden (2bones = 1Water) bald wird es eine andere Lösung geben.
- anpassung an der Landschaft. Patch kommt ca in 10 Minuten

notes.title: Hello Survivors! **First Official Update**
notes.content:
Thanks for being here! At Steam.
ːcsgoaː Firstly i want to let you all know that im a single programmer on this projekt, this projekt is for my twitch community and also for everyone how loves survival. As a single developer you will use assets done by other people or companys. So you will find games on steam that looks like my but in other ways, like same crafting system or a city. What i want to do is a cool storyline and a hudge crafting system. So if you want to get a game with maaaaaaany updates, you are in the right place!

ːZː The early access will start later this month. If you want to be a "beta tester" find me at gamescom at the Kinguin both. Just ask for JakeeYeXe and everyone will tell where i am ;)

ːcsgobː First Official Update:

- added a cool building with some cool stuff ːsteamwingsː
- added a NPC its very cute (Girlf will love it)
- added a handy as the "new" torch (i mean its 2017)
- new spawn positions
- now you will start at 19:00 so in the night. (dont be scary) ːsteamhappyː


Im open for all feedback, but please dont spam in the discuss with "your weapon looks like the same in game xy" i will fix that stuff fast as possible ːWoodAxeː

Yours
#JakeeYeXe
